Compute Stock-Watson (2008) panel-robust meat matrix

Source: R/vcov-sw.R
dot-sw_meat.Rd

Implements the bias-corrected per-panel estimator from Stock & Watson (2008, Econometrica, eq. 6). Panels with T <= 2 are skipped (SW is undefined). The meat has its own internal normalization: divided by (N - N_panels), NOT by N or (N - dofminus).

Usage

.sw_meat(
  basis,
  resid,
  ivar_vec,
  N,
  weights = NULL,
  weight_type = "aweight",
  center = FALSE,
  eZmean = NULL
)

Arguments

basis

N x P matrix (Z for diagnostics, X_hat for VCV).

resid

N-vector of residuals.

ivar_vec

N-vector of panel identifiers.

N

Integer: number of observations.

weights

Normalized weights or NULL.

weight_type

Character: "aweight" or "pweight".

center

Logical: if TRUE, subtract the global mean of moment conditions before computing the outer product.

eZmean

P-vector: pre-computed global mean of scores (used when center = TRUE), or NULL.

Value

P x P symmetric meat matrix (already normalized by 1/(N - N_panels)), or a zero matrix with a warning if all panels have T <= 2.
